chunks: This contending of the inmates of Hell will surely be real.
ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the dispute among the inhabitants of Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Sad underscores the finality of divine judgment, where the 'dispute' (khasam) of the Hellfire inhabitants is not a search for truth but a futile expression of regret and defiance. It serves as a warning that those who rejected guidance in the world will find their arguments invalid before Allah, emphasizing the reality of the Hereafter as a place of reckoning rather than debate.
